caption: The drawing features a single object composed of multiple parts positioned upright against a plain beige background. At the base is a brown, irregularly shaped, rock-like mass, upon which a metallic object resembling a pair of pliers or tongs with a twisted shaft is vertically attached. Extending outward from the twisted shaft, about halfway up, is a short horizontal arm supporting a small, cylindrical, metallic cup or holder. The main colors in the drawing are shades of brown and gray, with subtle highlights and shadows used to indicate the texture and dimensionality of the materials. The composition centers the object, with ample negative space surrounding it. The artist's name, "Howard N. Lombard," is faintly visible at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Candle Holder
